texts.preamble: Garlapathi Sathish Kumar, vs The State Of Telangana, on 3 October, 2024 Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy Writ Petition No.27504 Of 2024 Order :
texts.facts: (ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to declare the action of respondents No.3 and 4 in interfering with his business activity, without following due process of law, as being illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional. Despite the same, respondents No.3 and 4 are harassing the petitioner by alleging that he is selling pan masala products which contain tobacco and nicotin. Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is not selling any products, which contain tobacco and nicotin. 4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on the basis of the written instructions dated 01.10.2024, submitted that subsequent to the filing of this writ petition, respondent No.4 - the Station House Officer, Medipally Police Station, verified the station records and it was revealed that as of now, no complaint is pending/registered against the petitioner. It is further stated that respondent No.4 never called, raided, harassed, threatened, or interfered with the business activity of the petitioner nor has taken any coercive steps against him.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is not selling any tobacco products and there is no violation of provisions of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules made there under.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is not selling any tobacco products and there is no violation of provisions of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003 and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules made there under.
